Despite the country’s polarization, Democrats have also moved in the same direction. 民调表明，共和党人在对华问题上仍比民主党人更为鹰派，不过共和党人对中国的看法也变得更加正面——这或许反映了特朗普自身的立场转变。尽管美国存在政治极化，但民主党人也正朝着相同方向发展。 Just a year or two ago, politicians could “propose almost any kind of tough policy against China and the public would be behind it,” said Bruce Stokes, an expert on foreign policy polling at the German Marshall Fund, a think tank. “This public opinion data seems to suggest that support for a tough-on-China policy has weakened a little bit.” 仅仅一两年前，政客们“提出几乎任何针对中国的强硬政策，公众都会予以支持”，智库德国马歇尔基金会外交政策民调专家布鲁斯·斯托克斯说。“这些民调数据似乎表明，对强硬对华政策的支持已略有减弱。” Americans’ views of China, of course, could quickly shift again, especially amid fears of its artificial intelligence prowess and the risk of armed conflict over Taiwan. Pollsters note that Americans generally spend little time thinking about foreign policy and rarely let international issues determine how they vote. 当然，美国人对中国的看法可能会再次迅速转变，特别是在对其人工智能实力的担忧以及因台湾问题引发武装冲突风险的背景下。民调专家指出，美国人通常很少花时间思考外交政策，也极少让国际问题决定其投票意向。 But people who study the U.S. relationship with China see the polling figures as reflective of a changing geopolitical dynamic and, perhaps, angst over the United States’ place in the world. In the Pew and Chicago Council polls, younger adults are significantly more positively disposed toward China, evidence of a generational shift. 但研究美中关系的人士认为，民调数据反映出不断变化的地缘政治动态，或许也折射出对美国国际地位的焦虑。在皮尤和芝加哥委员会的民调中，较年轻成年人对中国的态度明显更加积极，这印证了代际转变。 “Younger people have known China as a superpower,” Ms. Silver, the Pew researcher, said. Older generations, by contrast, are more likely to associate China with the developing world, Communism and the Tiananmen Square massacre of 1989, she said. “年轻人所认识的中国是一个超级大国，”皮尤研究员西尔弗说。她表示，相比之下，老一代人更有可能将中国与发展中国家、共产主义以及1989年的天安门广场大屠杀联系起来。 Younger people may also be more aware of China’s technological innovations and cultural exports, as evidenced by the “Chinamaxxing” trends ricocheting around the internet . That awareness comes in contrast to a sense of a decline in the United States’ global standing: 62 percent of Americans say the country is respected less in the world today than it was 10 years ago, according to the Chicago Council. 年轻群体可能也对中国的技术创新和文化输出有更多认知，在互联网上风靡的 “中国最大化(Chinamaxxing)”趋势 便是明证。这种认知与对美国全球地位衰退的感受形成反差：根据芝加哥委员会的数据，62%的美国人认为，当今美国在世界上受到的尊重不如10年前。 “You see fears of what’s happening to America be refracted through assessments of China,” said Nick Zeller, a scholar at the Carter Center in Atlanta who tracks how China and the United States perceive each other. “This positive assessment toward China has more to do with American political tumult domestically than it does China itself.” “你会发现，对美国现状的恐惧通过对中国的评估折射出来，”位于亚特兰大的卡特中心追踪中美互视视角的学者尼克·泽勒表示。“这种对中国的正面评估更多地与美国国内的政治动荡有关，而非中国本身。” Anton Troianovski 自华盛顿为《纽约时报》报道有关美国外交政策和国家安全的文章。他此前曾在莫斯科和柏林任驻外记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

items.title: 倾国之力：习近平希望用人工智能助中国赢得未来
items.description: 王月眉2026年9月24日 Karolis Strautniekas In a stretch of former farmland now transformed into a gleaming technology park, China’s leader, Xi Jinping, watched two robotic hands slowly thread a needle. 在一座由农田改建的闪亮科技园区，中国国家主席习近平观看了两只机械手缓慢穿针引线的过程。 What he was seeing, he declared, would help China seize its future. 他宣布，他所看到的这一切将帮助中国抓住未来。 It is a future in which artificial intelligence permeates China’s factories, hospitals and classrooms, reinvigorating the economy through advanced robotics and high-end manufacturing. It is a future in which China, not the United States, dominates A.I. development, turning the technology into what Mr. Xi has called a “lead goose” to fly the country into its next economic revolution. 在这个未来中，人工智能将渗透至中国的工厂、医院和教室，通过先进机器人和高端制造重振经济。在这个未来中，将由中国而非美国主导人工智能的发展，把这项技术转化为习近平所称的“头雁”，引领国家飞向下一场经济革命。 To realize that vision, the Chinese government is mobilizing the full weight of the state. 为了实现这一愿景，中国政府正在动用倾国之力。 At the park that Mr. Xi visited, on the outskirts of Beijing in February, hundreds of companies have set up offices to develop cutting-edge chips and A.I. models. The city government is giving them tens of millions of dollars in free computing power. An exhibition hall shows off their creations, including chips designed to power nuclear missiles and brain implants that could help paralyzed patients speak. 在今年2月习近平访问的这个位于北京郊区的园区内，已有数百家企业设立办公点，研发尖端芯片和人工智能模型。市政府正向他们提供价值数千万美元的免费算力。一座展厅展示着这些企业的研发成果，其中包括用于驱动核导弹的芯片，以及能帮助瘫痪患者恢复语言能力的脑机接口。 Mr. Xi, during his visit, said that China’s strength lies in its ability to zero in on a direction and follow through. 习近平在考察期间表示，中国的优势在于能够锚定一个方向并贯彻到底。 “We must give full play to our nation’s advantage of concentrating resources to accomplish major tasks,” he told an assembled group of entrepreneurs, researchers and officials. 我们要“充分发挥我们国家集中力量办大事的优势”，他向在场的一群企业家、科研人员和官员表示。 China’s A.I. campaign is backed by enormous sums of government money. Economists estimate that state-led funds put more than $184 billion into A.I. firms between 2000 and 2023, and last year, the government and state-owned banks pledged hundreds of billions more. Private A.I. investment in China is far lower than in the United States, where private sources poured $285 billion into the technology in 2025 alone. 中国的人工智能攻势得到了巨额政府资金的支持。据经济学家估计，在2000年至2023年间，国家主导的基金向人工智能企业投入了超过1840亿美元，去年政府和国有银行又承诺提供数千亿美元。中国在人工智能领域的私人投资远低于美国，仅在2025年，美国的民间资本便向该技术倾注了2850亿美元。 Beijing’s approach to A.I. is distinct from the prevailing one in the United States in other ways, too. 北京对待人工智能的策略在其他方面也与美国的普遍做法截然不同。 Many in Washington and Silicon Valley see A.I. development as a race toward artificial general intelligence, a still-theoretical form of A.I. that could think and learn as well as — or better than — humans. 华盛顿和硅谷的许多人将人工智能的发展视为一场迈向通用人工智能(AGI)的竞赛，这是一种仍处于理论阶段的人工智能形式，旨在让人工智能做到像人类一样——甚至超越人类。 Chinese officials have hardly mentioned A.G.I., focusing on more immediate goals. 而中国官员几乎未曾提及通用人工智能，他们更关注立竿见影的目标。 China’s population is rapidly shrinking and getting older, creating an urgent need for intelligent robots to replace retiring workers. Poor rural residents could seek medical care from digital avatars of top urban doctors. The authorities could more easily know where Chinese citizens are, what they say and perhaps even how they feel. 中国人口正在迅速萎缩并走向老龄化，这催生了用智能机器人替代退休劳动力的迫切需求。贫困地区的农村居民可以向顶尖城市医生的数字替身寻求医疗服务。相关部门也能借此更轻易地掌握中国公民的行踪、言论，甚至可能感知他们的情绪。 The government has said that A.I.-powered tools and agents should permeate 90 percent of Chinese society by 2030, though it has not explained how that would be measured. 政府曾表示，到2030年，人工智能驱动的工具和智能体应覆盖90%的中国社会，不过并未解释将如何衡量这一目标。 Mr. Xi has also endorsed Chinese companies’ use of open-source models, which have helped them win users globally when leading American companies have released closed systems. 习近平还对中国企业使用开源模型表示认可。当领先的美国企业相继发布封闭系统时，开源策略已帮助中国企业赢得了全球用户。 China has embraced A.I. despite the potential risks it poses to the Communist Party’s legitimacy and tight grip on society. 尽管人工智能对共产党的合法性及其对社会的严密掌控构成了潜在风险，但中国依然拥抱了这项技术。 The technology is already displacing taxi drivers, actors and office workers, heightening worries about joblessness and potential unrest. 该技术已经在取代出租车司机、演员和办公室白领，加剧了人们对失业和潜在社会动荡的担忧。 Chatbots could threaten the party’s controls on information, while advanced foreign models like Claude Mythos could make it easier for China’s enemies to launch complex hacking attacks on its critical infrastructure — a threat the country’s top spy chief recently acknowledged. 聊天机器人可能会威胁到中共对信息的管控，而像Claude Mythos这样先进的外国模型可能会使中国的敌对势力更容易对其关键基础设施发动复杂的黑客攻击——中国国家安全部高级官员近期也承认了这一威胁。 Mr. Xi is betting that China can control those dangers. 习近平押注中国能够控制住这些危险。 Regulators have imposed strict rules on what chatbots can say and banned A.I. companion bots for children. Chinese courts have warned companies not to blindly replace workers with technology. The authorities have also barred some leading A.I. entrepreneurs from leaving China. 监管机构已对聊天机器人的发言内容施加了严格限制，并禁止了面向儿童的人工智能陪伴机器人。中国法院已警告企业不要盲目用技术取代工人。相关部门还限制了一些顶尖的人工智能企业家出境。 But Beijing’s confidence in its controls, and its determination to catch up with the United States, also mean it is skeptical of global calls to slow the pace of A.I. development. 但北京对其掌控力的信心以及赶超美国的决心也意味着其对全球要求放缓人工智能发展步伐的呼吁持怀疑态度。 In Beijing’s view, China is already fighting from behind. Washington has limited China’s access to the most advanced chips, so China lacks the computing power that is needed to train cutting-edge A.I. Agreeing to slow down now, in this view, would only cement America’s lead. 在北京看来，中国本就处在落后追赶的位置。华盛顿限制了中国获取最先进芯片的渠道，导致中国缺乏训练尖端人工智能所需的算力。基于这种观点，如果现在同意放慢脚步，只会巩固美国的领先地位。 The 2014 Speech That Started It All 开启一切的2014年讲话 In Beijing’s Great Hall of the People, China’s top scientists gathered for a speech by Mr. Xi. It was June 2014, the first time that Mr. Xi addressed China’s Academies of Engineering and Sciences as the country’s leader. 在北京人民大会堂，中国顶尖科学家齐聚一堂，聆听习近平的讲话。那是2014年6月，习近平首次以国家领导人身份在两院院士大会上讲话。 The attendees had submitted reports beforehand, and Mr. Xi said he had read them closely. He said he was particularly intrigued by one report predicting that A.I.-powered robots would soon transform the global economy. Such machines, unlike traditional robots that repeat specific preprogrammed tasks, can use A.I. to learn from and adapt to their surroundings. China would be the biggest market, the report said. 与会者事先提交了报告，习近平表示他已仔细阅读。他说自己对一份预测人工智能驱动的机器人将很快改变全球经济的报告特别感兴趣。与重复预设任务的传统机器人不同，这类机器能利用人工智能从周围环境中学习并适应。报告指出，中国将成为其最大的市场。 That wasn’t enough, Mr. Xi said. China should be not just the biggest buyer, but also the top maker. 习近平表示，这还不够。中国不仅应成为最大的买家，还应成为顶尖的制造者。 “Reading this, I wondered,” he added, “can our technology and manufacturing capabilities keep up with the competition?” “看到这里，我就在想，”他说，“我们的技术和制造能力能不能应对这场竞争？” That speech set off a frenzy that still shapes China’s A.I. policy today. 那次讲话掀起的一股热潮至今仍在塑造着中国的人工智能政策。 Immediately afterward, Pan Yunhe, the Chinese Academy of Engineering’s vice president and a respected A.I. researcher, organized a team to design a long-term strategy for the country, according to Gong Ke, a professor in Tianjin who leads an A.I. research institute under the academy. 据在天津负责管理该院下属一所人工智能研究院的龚克教授透露，会后不久，时任中国工程院副院长、备受尊敬的人工智能专家潘云鹤便组织团队，开始为国家设计一项长期战略。 China was well positioned to take the lead in A.I., Professor Pan wrote in a research paper shortly afterward, because its huge population ensured that there was both a great supply of data to train models, and great demand for intelligent products. He also wrote that China urgently needed A.I. to address problems that the country’s rapid modernization had created; smart manufacturing and A.I.-assisted education, for example, could help address issues such as pollution and inequality. (Professor Pan declined an interview request.) 潘云鹤在不久后发表的一篇研究论文中写道，中国非常有望在人工智能领域取得领先地位，因为其庞大的人口不仅能为训练模型提供海量数据，也为智能产品创造了巨大需求。他还写道，中国迫切需要人工智能来解决快速现代化带来的问题；例如，智能制造和人工智能辅助教育能够帮助应对污染和不平等等挑战。（潘云鹤拒绝了采访请求。） In 2017, China issued its first national A.I. plan, which, in parts, used language virtually identical to Professor Pan’s paper. It said that China should become a world leader in the technology by 2030. 2017年，中国发布了首个国家级人工智能发展规划，其中部分表述与潘云鹤的论文几乎如出一辙。规划提出，中国应在2030年成为该技术的世界领导者。 In the years after the plan was released, China’s A.I. sector expanded rapidly. State and private investors pumped in money. The number of A.I. patents by China soon blew past that of the United States. 在该规划发布后的几年里，中国的人工智能产业迅速扩张。国家和私人投资者注入了大量资金。中国的人工智能专利数量很快便超越了美国。 From the start, Beijing saw A.I. as a force, like the internet, that could shore up the party’s power. It could help maintain public satisfaction by boosting economic growth. It could also head off potential unrest by helping the party monitor China’s people. 从一开始，北京就将人工智能视作一种类似于互联网、能够巩固党执政地位的力量。它可以通过推动经济增长来帮助维持民众的满意度。它还能通过协助官方实施监控，防范潜在的社会动荡。 Manufacturers pushed A.I. into factories and warehouses. Surveillance companies became global leaders in facial and voice recognition. At one point in 2018, SenseTime, a Beijing-based company that has helped the government police China’s Uyghur minority, was the world’s most valuable A.I. start-up. 制造商将人工智能引入工厂和仓库。监控企业成为了面部和语音识别领域的全球领军者。2018年，曾协助政府对少数民族维吾尔人进行警务监控的北京企业商汤科技一度成为全球估值最高的人工智能初创公司。 But Chinese researchers were generally not focused on large language models, as American researchers were. When ChatGPT appeared in 2022, China reeled. Commentators who had boasted of China’s lead in A.I. asked why the breakthrough had not come from their country. 但当时中国研究人员普遍没有像美国同行那样专注于大型语言模型。当ChatGPT于2022年问世时，中国深受震动。曾经夸耀中国在人工智能领域处于领先地位的评论员不禁发问：为什么这一突破没有诞生在自己的国家？ Then, last year, came DeepSeek. The previously unknown Chinese start-up stunned the world by showing that Chinese firms could compete with Silicon Valley on large language models, too. In February 2025, a few weeks after DeepSeek released its model, Mr. Xi summoned a group of Chinese tech executives — including DeepSeek’s founder — to a meeting. 随后，深度求索(DeepSeek)在去年横空出世。这家此前默默无闻的中国初创公司向世界证明了中国企业在大型语言模型上同样能与硅谷一较高下，此举震惊了全球。2025年2月，即DeepSeek发布其模型几周后，习近平召集了一群中国科技企业高管举行座谈会，其中就包括DeepSeek的创始人。 “It is the right time for private enterprises and entrepreneurs to fully demonstrate their abilities,” he said. Those gathered must “unify our thinking” and “serve the country.” “广大民营企业和民营企业家大显身手正当其时，”他表示。与会者必须“统一思想”，并“胸怀报国志”。 A Recipe for Dominance 占据主导地位的秘诀 Beijing is not just tapping its biggest tech tycoons for that mission. State support is supercharging individual ambitions across the country, as Hobo Liang, a 42-year-old entrepreneur in the tech hub of Shenzhen, has seen firsthand. 为了实现这一使命，北京不仅在吸纳最顶尖的科技巨头。国家的支持也正在为全国各地个人的雄心壮志提供强大动力，在科技重镇深圳，42岁的创业者梁哲对此深有体会。 The son of mathematics professors in northern China, Mr. Liang was drawn to machines from an early age. In elementary school, he built homemade radios from spare parts. At university in the mid-2000s, he studied electrical engineering and decided to start a robotics company. 作为两位在北方任教的数学教授的儿子，梁哲从小就对机械着迷。小学时，他用废旧零件自制收音机。在2000年代中期的大学时代，他主修电气工程，并下定决心创办一家机器人公司。 People around him were doubtful. One potential investor asked Mr. Liang why China needed robots when it had so many people. His parents urged him to apply for stable jobs at state-owned companies. China’s high-tech sector was in its infancy, and many of Mr. Liang’s heroes were in the United States: Steve Jobs, Elon Musk. He even idolized a fictional entrepreneur — Tony Stark, of Marvel’s Iron Man movies. 身边的人对此表示怀疑。一位潜在投资者问他，既然中国人口众多，为什么还需要机器人。父母敦促他找一份国企的稳定工作。当时中国的高科技产业尚处在起步阶段，梁哲心目中的英雄大多在美国：史蒂夫·乔布斯、埃隆·马斯克。他甚至崇拜一位虚构的企业家——漫威电影《钢铁侠》中的托尼·斯塔克。 Today, Mr. Liang still keeps an Iron Man figurine on his desk. But that early skepticism feels far away. His start-up, Xeno Dynamics, which makes robotic exoskeletons for people with mobility issues, recently moved into a new government-built industrial park, next door to China’s leading drone maker. 如今，他的办公桌上依然摆放着一个钢铁侠手办。但当年哪些怀疑的声音已经感觉十分遥远。他创办的奇诺动力(Xeno Dynamics)专门为行动不便者制造外骨骼机器人，最近已搬进一个由政府新建的产业园，与中国首屈一指的无人机制造商比邻而居。 Xeno has been recognized as a national high-tech enterprise, meaning its tax rate is reduced from 25 percent to 15 percent. It has received over $1.4 million in government research funds, as well as multiple rounds of venture capital funding. 奇诺动力已被认定为国家高新技术企业，这意味着其企业所得税率由25%降至15%。该公司已获得逾1000万元的政府研发资金，以及多轮风险投资。 2025年，奇诺动力联合创始人兼董事长梁哲在中国深圳的办公室里。他的公司为行动不便的人制造机器人外骨骼。 “We’re beneficiaries of the entire direction — whether it’s about robots, or A.I.,” Mr. Liang said in an interview in his office. “You have to follow the direction of major policies.” “这个方向正好我们是个受益者，不管从机器人来讲，AI也好，还是从现在讲的银发经济，我们都是受益者，”梁哲在其办公室接受采访时说。“所以这个就是跟着这个大的政策方向走，一定是这样。” In many ways, China’s playbook for A.I. mirrors the one it used to dominate electric vehicles and solar panels: subsidies, tax breaks and research money. 在许多方面，中国发展人工智能的策略与其在电动汽车和太阳能电池板领域占据主导地位的策略如出一辙：补贴、税收减免和研发资金。 A district in Shanghai offered up to $29 million to any A.I. company that achieved a major “breakthrough.” A university hub in Beijing said it had spent about $580 million on A.I. last year, funding data annotation centers, labs and housing for researchers. 上海的一个区政府提出，将向任何取得重大“突破”的人工智能企业提供最高达2亿元的奖励。北京一处大学城表示去年在人工智能领域投入了约40亿元，用于资助数据标注中心、实验室以及为研究人员提供住房。 In Shenzhen, officials spent more than $6 billion on the industrial park where Xeno’s offices are located. The district also promised to help robotics companies find potential customers. 在深圳，官方耗资逾60亿美元建设了奇诺动力所在的产业园。区政府还承诺协助机器人企业寻找潜在客户。 The central government, for its part, has been spending heavily on physical infrastructure. Beijing’s newest five-year plan calls for building ultra-large computing clusters and ensuring electricity to power the A.I. boom. Officials are also setting up a national exchange to trade data to train A.I. models. 而中央政府一直在实体基础设施上投入巨资。北京最新的五年规划要求建设超大型计算集群，并确保电力供应以支撑人工智能热潮。官员们还正在筹建一个全国交易所，用于买卖训练人工智能模型所需的数据。 The Limits of State Planning 国家规划的局限性 But it may be harder for Beijing to engineer mastery in A.I. than in electric vehicles or solar panels. 然而，北京若想在人工智能领域取得像在电动汽车或太阳能电池板那样的掌控力，可能难度更大。 In those sectors, the technology was fairly developed, and the state’s role was giving companies the financial support to edge out foreign competitors, said Cole McFaul, a researcher at the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. 乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心研究员科尔·麦克福尔表示，在这些行业，技术已经相对成熟，国家的角色在于给予企业资金支持以挤走外国竞争对手。 With A.I., leadership will hinge on technological breakthroughs. Subsidies can do only so much. 但对于人工智能而言，能否占据领导地位将取决于技术突破。补贴的作用终究有限。 One obstacle is a shortage of specialized talent. Another is the lack of access to the most powerful chips. Indeed, DeepSeek’s founder, Liang Wenfeng, has said that the company needs high-end chips, not more money. 障碍之一是专业人才匮乏。其二则是无法获取最强大的芯片。事实上，DeepSeek创始人梁文锋曾表示，公司需要的是高端芯片，而不是更多的资金。 The government is trying to close those gaps. It has poured more than $150 billion into a decadelong effort to develop domestic cutting-edge chips, though that has not yet yielded major successes. It is also working to train more scientific talent. 中国政府正努力弥补这些差距。政府已投入逾1500亿美元，开展了一项为期十年的自主尖端芯片研发计划，尽管目前尚未取得重大成功。政府也正努力培养更多科研人才。 Still, “those are long-term strategies, when the challenges right now are much more pressing,” Mr. McFaul said. “这些终归是长期战略，而眼下的挑战要紧迫得多，”麦克福尔说。 Officials have acknowledged the need to give the private sector more room. Private companies like DeepSeek and Alibaba, not state-owned giants, have driven China’s breakthroughs. 官员们已经意识到有必要给予私营部门更多空间。推动中国取得突破的是像DeepSeek和阿里巴巴这样的民营企业，而非国有巨头。 Karolis Strautniekas Instead of micromanaging research, officials have focused on stimulating demand for A.I. Local governments have rushed to embed A.I. in hospitals, schools and traffic systems. Last year, Zhejiang Province organized mass study sessions about A.I., with more than 220,000 party officials watching a live-streamed lecture by a Tsinghua University scholar. 官员们没有对研发进行微观干预，而是将重点放在刺激人工智能的需求上。地方政府纷纷将人工智能融入医院、学校和交通系统中。去年，浙江省组织了关于人工智能的群众性学习活动，逾22万名党员干部观看了由一位清华大学学者主讲的直播课程。 The authorities have even rolled back some of their most burdensome rules. 当局甚至撤销了一些最为繁琐的规定。 Soon after ChatGPT’s release, the party had proposed strict regulations on chatbots and other generative A.I., requiring platforms to guarantee that A.I.-generated output was “true and accurate.” After companies argued that would be impossible, that requirement disappeared from the final rules. 就在ChatGPT发布后不久，中共曾提出对聊天机器人和其他生成式人工智能实施严格监管，要求平台保证人工智能生成的内容“真实准确”。在企业提出这根本无法实现之后，最终出台的管理办法中已经看不到该要求。 Li Zhiqi, a policy adviser to the Beijing city government, said he helped channel feedback from companies to officials, and had proposed suggestions such as faster deployment of self-driving cars. “The government isn’t just making rules behind closed doors,” he said. 北京市政府政策顾问李志起表示，他协助将企业的反馈意见传达给官员，并提出了加快自动驾驶汽车部署等建议。“政府也不会是这种一味的闭门造车，”他说。 The Race to the Top 巅峰之战 For now, the approach seems to be working. At the end of 2025, China had more than 6,000 A.I. companies, and its core A.I. industry was worth $171 billion, according to official statistics. Chinese models now consistently outnumber American ones on a list of the most popular A.I. systems worldwide, according to OpenRouter, a closely watched leaderboard of A.I. models. Even Western tech companies like Airbnb have embraced them. 就目前而言，这种方法似乎奏效了。据官方统计，截至2025年底，中国拥有超过6000家人工智能企业，核心人工智能产业规模达1710亿美元。备受关注的人工智能模型排行榜OpenRouter显示，在全球最受欢迎的人工智能系统榜单上，中国模型的数量目前始终力压美国模型。甚至连Airbnb等西方科技公司也拥抱了这些中国模型。 Two Chinese companies recently introduced models that are nearly as powerful as the leading American model, Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5, and cost much less to use. 两家中国企业近期发布了与领先的美国模型——Anthropic的Claude Fable 5性能几乎相当、但使用成本要低得多的模型。 Robots — the sector Mr. Xi first championed in his 2014 speech — have been a particular success. China has more than 2 million robots in its factories, more than in the rest of the world combined. Some Chinese researchers have argued that robots may be more promising for achieving general-purpose intelligence than large language models — Silicon Valley’s chosen method — because they can learn from interactions with the physical world. 习近平在2014年讲话中首先提倡的机器人领域取得了尤为突出的成功。中国工厂里拥有超过200万台机器人，数量比世界其他地区的总和还要多。一些中国研究人员已经提出，在实现通用人工智能方面，机器人或许比大型语言模型（硅谷所选择的路径）更具潜力，因为它们能够从与物理世界的交互中学习。 Those rapid gains have fueled anxiety in Washington, where fears of being overtaken by China have become the main argument against reining in A.I. A congressional advisory group warned that China’s quick adoption of A.I. in robots and other practical applications would generate huge amounts of new data that could then be used to further improve its models. In July, the U.S. government proposed restricting imports of humanoid robots, a move Beijing denounced as discriminatory. 这些飞速进步加剧了华盛顿的焦虑，在那里，被中国超越的恐惧已成为反对约束人工智能发展的主要论点。一家国会咨询机构警告称，中国在机器人和其他实际应用中迅速推广人工智能将产生海量新数据，这些数据随后可用于进一步提升其模型性能。今年7月，美国政府提议限制人形机器人的进口，北京方面谴责此举具有歧视性。 For people like Mr. Liang, the robotics company founder in Shenzhen, the signs of China’s progress are already all around. 对于像深圳机器人公司创始人梁哲这样的人而言，中国取得进步的迹象已随处可见。 He still admires American entrepreneurs, but he no longer looks only to them for inspiration. He wears smart glasses from Huawei. He has hired interns from American universities who are eager to learn from China’s robotics expertise. 他依然钦佩美国企业家，但他已不再只从他们身上获得启迪。他戴着华为智能眼镜。他聘用了来自美国大学的实习生，这些年轻人渴望学习中国机器人技术领域的专业知识。 “Before, we all used American technology as the benchmark, and we’d joke about ‘C-to-C’: ‘copy to China,’” Mr. Liang said. “I think it’s the mission of this generation of Chinese entrepreneurs to let the world know that some Chinese companies are different.” “以前我们开玩笑就是摸着美国的科技圈过河，你有什么我有这个对标就完了。很多年前中国讲的模式就是C to C(Copy to China)，”梁哲说。“我觉得这其实是这一代中国企业家一个使命，就是让世界要知道中国其实有一些企业是不一样的。” Siyi Zhao对本文有研究贡献。 王月眉(Vivian Wang)是时报驻纽约记者，报道中国的崛起及雄心如何影响中国国内外民众的生活。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
items.content: 王月眉 2026年9月24日 Karolis Strautniekas In a stretch of former farmland now transformed into a gleaming technology park, China’s leader, Xi Jinping, watched two robotic hands slowly thread a needle. 在一座由农田改建的闪亮科技园区，中国国家主席习近平观看了两只机械手缓慢穿针引线的过程。 What he was seeing, he declared, would help China seize its future. 他宣布，他所看到的这一切将帮助中国抓住未来。 It is a future in which artificial intelligence permeates China’s factories, hospitals and classrooms, reinvigorating the economy through advanced robotics and high-end manufacturing. It is a future in which China, not the United States, dominates A.I. development, turning the technology into what Mr. Xi has called a “lead goose” to fly the country into its next economic revolution. 在这个未来中，人工智能将渗透至中国的工厂、医院和教室，通过先进机器人和高端制造重振经济。在这个未来中，将由中国而非美国主导人工智能的发展，把这项技术转化为习近平所称的“头雁”，引领国家飞向下一场经济革命。 To realize that vision, the Chinese government is mobilizing the full weight of the state. 为了实现这一愿景，中国政府正在动用倾国之力。 At the park that Mr. Xi visited , on the outskirts of Beijing in February, hundreds of companies have set up offices to develop cutting-edge chips and A.I. models. The city government is giving them tens of millions of dollars in free computing power. An exhibition hall shows off their creations, including chips designed to power nuclear missiles and brain implants that could help paralyzed patients speak. 在今年2月 习近平访问的 这个位于北京郊区的园区内，已有数百家企业设立办公点，研发尖端芯片和人工智能模型。市政府正 向他们提供 价值数千万美元的免费算力。一座展厅展示着这些企业的研发成果，其中包括用于驱动核导弹的芯片，以及能帮助瘫痪患者恢复语言能力的脑机接口。 Mr. Xi, during his visit, said that China’s strength lies in its ability to zero in on a direction and follow through. 习近平在考察期间表示，中国的优势在于能够锚定一个方向并贯彻到底。 “We must give full play to our nation’s advantage of concentrating resources to accomplish major tasks,” he told an assembled group of entrepreneurs, researchers and officials. 我们要“充分发挥我们国家集中力量办大事的优势”，他 向在场的一群 企业家、科研人员和官员表示。 China’s A.I. campaign is backed by enormous sums of government money. Economists estimate that state-led funds put more than $184 billion into A.I. firms between 2000 and 2023, and last year, the government and state-owned banks pledged hundreds of billions more. Private A.I. investment in China is far lower than in the United States, where private sources poured $285 billion into the technology in 2025 alone. 中国的人工智能攻势得到了巨额政府资金的支持。据经济学家 估计 ，在2000年至2023年间，国家主导的基金向人工智能企业投入了超过1840亿美元，去年 政府 和 国有银行 又承诺提供数千亿美元。中国在人工智能领域的私人投资远低于美国，仅在2025年，美国的 民间资本 便向该技术倾注了2850亿美元。 Beijing’s approach to A.I. is distinct from the prevailing one in the United States in other ways, too. 北京对待人工智能的策略在其他方面也与美国的普遍做法截然不同。 Many in Washington and Silicon Valley see A.I. development as a race toward artificial general intelligence, a still-theoretical form of A.I. that could think and learn as well as — or better than — humans. 华盛顿和硅谷的许多人将人工智能的发展视为一场迈向通用人工智能(AGI)的竞赛，这是一种仍处于理论阶段的人工智能形式，旨在让人工智能做到像人类一样——甚至超越人类。 Chinese officials have hardly mentioned A.G.I., focusing on more immediate goals. 而中国官员几乎未曾提及通用人工智能，他们更关注立竿见影的目标。 China’s population is rapidly shrinking and getting older, creating an urgent need for intelligent robots to replace retiring workers. Poor rural residents could seek medical care from digital avatars of top urban doctors. The authorities could more easily know where Chinese citizens are, what they say and perhaps even how they feel. 中国人口正在迅速萎缩并走向老龄化，这催生了用智能机器人替代退休劳动力的迫切需求。贫困地区的农村居民可以向顶尖城市医生的数字替身寻求医疗服务。相关部门也能借此更轻易地 掌握中国公民 的行踪、言论，甚至可能感知他们的情绪。 The government has said that A.I.-powered tools and agents should permeate 90 percent of Chinese society by 2030, though it has not explained how that would be measured. 政府曾表示，到2030年，人工智能驱动的工具和智能体应覆盖90%的中国社会，不过并未解释将如何衡量这一目标。 Mr. Xi has also endorsed Chinese companies’ use of open-source models, which have helped them win users globally when leading American companies have released closed systems. 习近平还对中国企业使用 开源模型 表示认可。当领先的美国企业相继发布封闭系统时，开源策略已帮助中国企业赢得了全球用户。 China has embraced A.I. despite the potential risks it poses to the Communist Party’s legitimacy and tight grip on society. 尽管人工智能对共产党的合法性及其对社会的严密掌控构成了潜在风险，但中国依然拥抱了这项技术。 The technology is already displacing taxi drivers, actors and office workers, heightening worries about joblessness and potential unrest. 该技术已经在取代出租车司机、演员和办公室白领，加剧了人们对失业和潜在社会动荡的担忧。 Chatbots could threaten the party’s controls on information, while advanced foreign models like Claude Mythos could make it easier for China’s enemies to launch complex hacking attacks on its critical infrastructure — a threat the country’s top spy chief recently acknowledged . 聊天机器人可能会威胁到中共对信息的管控，而像 Claude Mythos 这样先进的外国模型可能会使中国的敌对势力更容易对其关键基础设施发动复杂的黑客攻击——中国国家安全部高级官员 近期也承认了 这一威胁。 Mr. Xi is betting that China can control those dangers. 习近平押注中国能够控制住这些危险。 Regulators have imposed strict rules on what chatbots can say and banned A.I. companion bots for children. Chinese courts have warned companies not to blindly replace workers with technology. The authorities have also barred some leading A.I. entrepreneurs from leaving China. 监管机构已对聊天机器人的发言内容施加了严格限制，并禁止了面向儿童的人工智能陪伴机器人。中国法院已警告企业不要盲目用技术取代工人。相关部门还限制了一些顶尖的人工智能企业家出境。 But Beijing’s confidence in its controls, and its determination to catch up with the United States, also mean it is skeptical of global calls to slow the pace of A.I. development. 但北京对其掌控力的信心以及赶超美国的决心也意味着其对全球要求 放缓 人工智能发展步伐的呼吁持怀疑态度。 In Beijing’s view, China is already fighting from behind. Washington has limited China’s access to the most advanced chips, so China lacks the computing power that is needed to train cutting-edge A.I. Agreeing to slow down now, in this view, would only cement America’s lead. 在北京看来，中国本就处在落后追赶的位置。华盛顿限制了中国获取最先进芯片的渠道，导致中国缺乏训练尖端人工智能所需的算力。基于这种观点，如果现在同意放慢脚步，只会巩固美国的领先地位。 The 2014 Speech That Started It All 开启一切的2014年讲话 In Beijing’s Great Hall of the People, China’s top scientists gathered for a speech by Mr. Xi. It was June 2014, the first time that Mr. Xi addressed China’s Academies of Engineering and Sciences as the country’s leader. 在北京人民大会堂，中国顶尖科学家齐聚一堂，聆听习近平的讲话。那是2014年6月，习近平首次以国家领导人身份在两院院士大会上讲话。 The attendees had submitted reports beforehand, and Mr. Xi said he had read them closely. He said he was particularly intrigued by one report predicting that A.I.-powered robots would soon transform the global economy. Such machines, unlike traditional robots that repeat specific preprogrammed tasks, can use A.I. to learn from and adapt to their surroundings. China would be the biggest market, the report said. 与会者事先提交了报告，习近平表示他已仔细阅读。他说自己对一份预测人工智能驱动的机器人将很快改变全球经济的报告特别感兴趣。与重复预设任务的传统机器人不同，这类机器能利用人工智能从周围环境中学习并适应。报告指出，中国将成为其最大的市场。 That wasn’t enough, Mr. Xi said. China should be not just the biggest buyer, but also the top maker. 习近平表示，这还不够。中国不仅应成为最大的买家，还应成为顶尖的制造者。 “Reading this, I wondered,” he added , “can our technology and manufacturing capabilities keep up with the competition?” “看到这里，我就在想，” 他说 ，“我们的技术和制造能力能不能应对这场竞争？” That speech set off a frenzy that still shapes China’s A.I. policy today. 那次讲话掀起的一股热潮至今仍在塑造着中国的人工智能政策。 Immediately afterward, Pan Yunhe, the Chinese Academy of Engineering’s vice president and a respected A.I. researcher, organized a team to design a long-term strategy for the country, according to Gong Ke, a professor in Tianjin who leads an A.I. research institute under the academy. 据在天津负责管理该院下属一所人工智能研究院的龚克教授透露，会后不久，时任中国工程院副院长、备受尊敬的人工智能专家潘云鹤便组织团队，开始为国家设计一项长期战略。 China was well positioned to take the lead in A.I., Professor Pan wrote in a research paper shortly afterward, because its huge population ensured that there was both a great supply of data to train models, and great demand for intelligent products. He also wrote that China urgently needed A.I. to address problems that the country’s rapid modernization had created; smart manufacturing and A.I.-assisted education, for example, could help address issues such as pollution and inequality. (Professor Pan declined an interview request.) 潘云鹤在不久后发表的 一篇研究论文中 写道，中国非常有望在人工智能领域取得领先地位，因为其庞大的人口不仅能为训练模型提供海量数据，也为智能产品创造了巨大需求。他还写道，中国迫切需要人工智能来解决快速现代化带来的问题；例如，智能制造和人工智能辅助教育能够帮助应对污染和不平等等挑战。（潘云鹤拒绝了采访请求。） In 2017, China issued its first national A.I. plan , which, in parts, used language virtually identical to Professor Pan’s paper. It said that China should become a world leader in the technology by 2030. 2017年，中国发布了首个国家级人工智能 发展规划 ，其中部分表述与潘云鹤的论文几乎如出一辙。规划提出，中国应在2030年成为该技术的世界领导者。 In the years after the plan was released, China’s A.I. sector expanded rapidly . State and private investors pumped in money. The number of A.I. patents by China soon blew past that of the United States. 在该规划发布后的几年里，中国的人工智能产业 迅速扩张 。国家和私人投资者注入了大量资金。中国的人工智能 专利 数量很快便超越了美国。 From the start, Beijing saw A.I. as a force, like the internet, that could shore up the party’s power. It could help maintain public satisfaction by boosting economic growth. It could also head off potential unrest by helping the party monitor China’s people. 从一开始，北京就将人工智能视作一种类似于互联网、能够巩固党执政地位的力量。它可以通过推动经济增长来帮助维持民众的满意度。它还能通过协助官方实施监控，防范潜在的社会动荡。 Manufacturers pushed A.I. into factories and warehouses. Surveillance companies became global leaders in facial and voice recognition. At one point in 2018, SenseTime, a Beijing-based company that has helped the government police China’s Uyghur minority , was the world’s most valuable A.I. start-up . 制造商将人工智能引入工厂和仓库。监控企业成为了面部和语音识别领域的全球领军者。2018年，曾 协助政府对少数民族维吾尔人进行警务监控的 北京企业商汤科技一度成为 全球估值最高的人工智能初创公司 。 But Chinese researchers were generally not focused on large language models, as American researchers were. When ChatGPT appeared in 2022, China reeled. Commentators who had boasted of China’s lead in A.I. asked why the breakthrough had not come from their country. 但当时中国研究人员普遍没有像美国同行那样专注于大型语言模型。当ChatGPT于2022年问世时，中国深受震动。曾经夸耀中国在人工智能领域处于领先地位的评论员不禁发问：为什么这一突破没有诞生在自己的国家？ Then, last year, came DeepSeek. The previously unknown Chinese start-up stunned the world by showing that Chinese firms could compete with Silicon Valley on large language models, too. In February 2025, a few weeks after DeepSeek released its model, Mr. Xi summoned a group of Chinese tech executives — including DeepSeek’s founder — to a meeting. 随后，深度求索(DeepSeek)在去年横空出世。这家此前默默无闻的中国初创公司向世界证明了中国企业在大型语言模型上同样能与硅谷一较高下，此举 震惊了全球 。2025年2月，即DeepSeek发布其模型几周后，习近平 召集了一群中国科技企业高管 举行座谈会，其中就包括DeepSeek的创始人。 “It is the right time for private enterprises and entrepreneurs to fully demonstrate their abilities,” he said . Those gathered must “unify our thinking” and “serve the country.” “广大民营企业和民营企业家大显身手正当其时，” 他表示 。与会者必须“统一思想”，并“胸怀报国志”。 A Recipe for Dominance 占据主导地位的秘诀 Beijing is not just tapping its biggest tech tycoons for that mission. State support is supercharging individual ambitions across the country, as Hobo Liang, a 42-year-old entrepreneur in the tech hub of Shenzhen, has seen firsthand. 为了实现这一使命，北京不仅在吸纳最顶尖的科技巨头。国家的支持也正在为全国各地个人的雄心壮志提供强大动力，在科技重镇深圳，42岁的创业者梁哲对此深有体会。 The son of mathematics professors in northern China, Mr. Liang was drawn to machines from an early age. In elementary school, he built homemade radios from spare parts. At university in the mid-2000s, he studied electrical engineering and decided to start a robotics company. 作为两位在北方任教的数学教授的儿子，梁哲从小就对机械着迷。小学时，他用废旧零件自制收音机。在2000年代中期的大学时代，他主修电气工程，并下定决心创办一家机器人公司。 People around him were doubtful. One potential investor asked Mr. Liang why China needed robots when it had so many people. His parents urged him to apply for stable jobs at state-owned companies. China’s high-tech sector was in its infancy, and many of Mr. Liang’s heroes were in the United States: Steve Jobs, Elon Musk. He even idolized a fictional entrepreneur — Tony Stark, of Marvel’s Iron Man movies. 身边的人对此表示怀疑。一位潜在投资者问他，既然中国人口众多，为什么还需要机器人。父母敦促他找一份国企的稳定工作。当时中国的高科技产业尚处在起步阶段，梁哲心目中的英雄大多在美国：史蒂夫·乔布斯、埃隆·马斯克。他甚至崇拜一位虚构的企业家——漫威电影《钢铁侠》中的托尼·斯塔克。 Today, Mr. Liang still keeps an Iron Man figurine on his desk. But that early skepticism feels far away. His start-up, Xeno Dynamics, which makes robotic exoskeletons for people with mobility issues, recently moved into a new government-built industrial park, next door to China’s leading drone maker. 如今，他的办公桌上依然摆放着一个钢铁侠手办。但当年哪些怀疑的声音已经感觉十分遥远。他创办的奇诺动力(Xeno Dynamics)专门为行动不便者制造外骨骼机器人，最近已搬进一个由政府新建的产业园，与中国首屈一指的无人机制造商比邻而居。 Xeno has been recognized as a national high-tech enterprise, meaning its tax rate is reduced from 25 percent to 15 percent. It has received over $1.4 million in government research funds, as well as multiple rounds of venture capital funding. 奇诺动力已被认定为国家高新技术企业，这意味着其企业所得税率由25%降至15%。该公司已获得逾1000万元的政府研发资金，以及多轮风险投资。 2025年，奇诺动力联合创始人兼董事长梁哲在中国深圳的办公室里。他的公司为行动不便的人制造机器人外骨骼。 “We’re beneficiaries of the entire direction — whether it’s about robots, or A.I.,” Mr. Liang said in an interview in his office. “You have to follow the direction of major policies.” “这个方向正好我们是个受益者，不管从机器人来讲，AI也好，还是从现在讲的银发经济，我们都是受益者，”梁哲在其办公室接受采访时说。“所以这个就是跟着这个大的政策方向走，一定是这样。” In many ways, China’s playbook for A.I. mirrors the one it used to dominate electric vehicles and solar panels : subsidies, tax breaks and research money. 在许多方面，中国发展人工智能的策略与其在 电动汽车和太阳能电池板 领域占据主导地位的策略如出一辙：补贴、税收减免和研发资金。 A district in Shanghai offered up to $29 million to any A.I. company that achieved a major “breakthrough.” A university hub in Beijing said it had spent about $580 million on A.I. last year, funding data annotation centers, labs and housing for researchers. 上海的一个区政府 提出 ，将向任何取得重大“突破”的人工智能企业提供最高达2亿元的奖励。北京一处大学城 表示 去年在人工智能领域投入了约40亿元，用于资助数据标注中心、实验室以及为研究人员提供住房。 In Shenzhen, officials spent more than $6 billion on the industrial park where Xeno’s offices are located. The district also promised to help robotics companies find potential customers. 在深圳，官方耗资逾60亿美元建设了奇诺动力所在的产业园。区政府还承诺协助机器人企业寻找潜在客户。 The central government, for its part, has been spending heavily on physical infrastructure. Beijing’s newest five-year plan calls for building ultra-large computing clusters and ensuring electricity to power the A.I. boom. Officials are also setting up a national exchange to trade data to train A.I. models. 而中央政府一直在实体基础设施上投入巨资。北京最新的五年规划要求建设超大型计算集群，并确保电力供应以支撑人工智能热潮。官员们还正在 筹建一个全国交易所 ，用于买卖训练人工智能模型所需的数据。 The Limits of State Planning 国家规划的局限性 But it may be harder for Beijing to engineer mastery in A.I. than in electric vehicles or solar panels. 然而，北京若想在人工智能领域取得像在电动汽车或太阳能电池板那样的掌控力，可能难度更大。 In those sectors, the technology was fairly developed, and the state’s role was giving companies the financial support to edge out foreign competitors, said Cole McFaul, a researcher at the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. 乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心研究员科尔·麦克福尔表示，在这些行业，技术已经相对成熟，国家的角色在于给予企业资金支持以挤走外国竞争对手。 With A.I., leadership will hinge on technological breakthroughs. Subsidies can do only so much. 但对于人工智能而言，能否占据领导地位将取决于技术突破。补贴的作用终究有限。 One obstacle is a shortage of specialized talent. Another is the lack of access to the most powerful chips. Indeed, DeepSeek’s founder, Liang Wenfeng, has said that the company needs high-end chips, not more money. 障碍之一是专业人才匮乏。其二则是无法获取最强大的芯片。事实上，DeepSeek创始人梁文锋 曾表示 ，公司需要的是高端芯片，而不是更多的资金。 The government is trying to close those gaps. It has poured more than $150 billion into a decadelong effort to develop domestic cutting-edge chips, though that has not yet yielded major successes. It is also working to train more scientific talent. 中国政府正努力弥补这些差距。政府 已投入逾1500亿美元 ，开展了一项为期十年的自主尖端芯片研发计划，尽管目前尚未取得重大成功。政府也正努力培养更多科研人才。 Still, “those are long-term strategies, when the challenges right now are much more pressing,” Mr. McFaul said. “这些终归是长期战略，而眼下的挑战要紧迫得多，”麦克福尔说。 Officials have acknowledged the need to give the private sector more room. Private companies like DeepSeek and Alibaba , not state-owned giants, have driven China’s breakthroughs. 官员们已经意识到有必要给予私营部门更多空间。推动中国取得突破的是像DeepSeek和 阿里巴巴 这样的民营企业，而非国有巨头。 Karolis Strautniekas Instead of micromanaging research, officials have focused on stimulating demand for A.I. Local governments have rushed to embed A.I. in hospitals, schools and traffic systems. Last year, Zhejiang Province organized mass study sessions about A.I., with more than 220,000 party officials watching a live-streamed lecture by a Tsinghua University scholar. 官员们没有对研发进行微观干预，而是将重点放在刺激人工智能的需求上。 地方政府纷纷将人工智能融入 医院、学校和交通系统中。去年，浙江省组织了关于人工智能的 群众性学习活动 ，逾22万名党员干部观看了由一位清华大学学者主讲的直播课程。 The authorities have even rolled back some of their most burdensome rules. 当局甚至撤销了一些最为繁琐的规定。 Soon after ChatGPT’s release, the party had proposed strict regulations on chatbots and other generative A.I., requiring platforms to guarantee that A.I.-generated output was “true and accurate.” After companies argued that would be impossible, that requirement disappeared from the final rules. 就在ChatGPT发布后不久，中共曾提出对聊天机器人和其他生成式人工智能实施严格监管，要求平台 保证人工智能生成的内容“真实准确” 。在企业提出这根本无法实现之后，最终出台的管理办法中已经看不到 该要求 。 Li Zhiqi, a policy adviser to the Beijing city government, said he helped channel feedback from companies to officials, and had proposed suggestions such as faster deployment of self-driving cars. “The government isn’t just making rules behind closed doors,” he said. 北京市政府政策顾问李志起表示，他协助将企业的反馈意见传达给官员，并提出了加快自动驾驶汽车部署等建议。“政府也不会是这种一味的闭门造车，”他说。 The Race to the Top 巅峰之战 For now, the approach seems to be working. At the end of 2025, China had more than 6,000 A.I. companies, and its core A.I. industry was worth $171 billion, according to official statistics . Chinese models now consistently outnumber American ones on a list of the most popular A.I. systems worldwide, according to OpenRouter, a closely watched leaderboard of A.I. models . Even Western tech companies like Airbnb have embraced them. 就目前而言，这种方法似乎奏效了。据 官方统计 ，截至2025年底，中国拥有超过6000家人工智能企业，核心人工智能产业规模达1710亿美元。备受关注的 人工智能模型排行榜 OpenRouter显示，在全球最受欢迎的人工智能系统榜单上，中国模型的数量目前始终 力压美国模型 。甚至连Airbnb等西方科技公司也拥抱了这些中国模型。 Two Chinese companies recently introduced models that are nearly as powerful as the leading American model, Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5, and cost much less to use. 两家中国企业 近期发布了 与领先的美国模型——Anthropic的Claude Fable 5性能几乎相当、但使用成本要低得多的模型。 Robots — the sector Mr. Xi first championed in his 2014 speech — have been a particular success. China has more than 2 million robots in its factories, more than in the rest of the world combined . Some Chinese researchers have argued that robots may be more promising for achieving general-purpose intelligence than large language models — Silicon Valley’s chosen method — because they can learn from interactions with the physical world. 习近平在2014年讲话中首先提倡的机器人领域取得了尤为突出的成功。中国工厂里拥有超过200万台机器人，数量比 世界其他地区的总和 还要多。一些中国研究人员 已经 提出 ，在实现通用人工智能方面，机器人或许比大型语言模型（硅谷所选择的路径）更具潜力，因为它们能够从与物理世界的交互中学习。 Those rapid gains have fueled anxiety in Washington, where fears of being overtaken by China have become the main argument against reining in A.I. A congressional advisory group warned that China’s quick adoption of A.I. in robots and other practical applications would generate huge amounts of new data that could then be used to further improve its models. In July, the U.S. government proposed restricting imports of humanoid robots, a move Beijing denounced as discriminatory . 这些飞速进步加剧了华盛顿的焦虑，在那里， 被中国超越的恐惧 已成为反对约束人工智能发展的主要论点。一家国会咨询机构 警告 称，中国在机器人和其他实际应用中迅速推广人工智能将产生海量新数据，这些数据随后可用于进一步提升其模型性能。今年7月，美国政府提议限制人形机器人的进口，北京方面谴责此举具有 歧视性 。 For people like Mr. Liang, the robotics company founder in Shenzhen, the signs of China’s progress are already all around. 对于像深圳机器人公司创始人梁哲这样的人而言，中国取得进步的迹象已随处可见。 He still admires American entrepreneurs, but he no longer looks only to them for inspiration. He wears smart glasses from Huawei. He has hired interns from American universities who are eager to learn from China’s robotics expertise. 他依然钦佩美国企业家，但他已不再只从他们身上获得启迪。他戴着华为智能眼镜。他聘用了来自美国大学的实习生，这些年轻人渴望学习中国机器人技术领域的专业知识。 “Before, we all used American technology as the benchmark, and we’d joke about ‘C-to-C’: ‘copy to China,’” Mr. Liang said. “I think it’s the mission of this generation of Chinese entrepreneurs to let the world know that some Chinese companies are different.” “以前我们开玩笑就是摸着美国的科技圈过河，你有什么我有这个对标就完了。很多年前中国讲的模式就是C to C(Copy to China)，”梁哲说。“我觉得这其实是这一代中国企业家一个使命，就是让世界要知道中国其实有一些企业是不一样的。” Siyi Zhao对本文有研究贡献。 王月眉( Vivian Wang )是时报驻纽约记者，报道中国的崛起及雄心如何影响中国国内外民众的生活。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 贝森特：美中同意将贸易休战期延长两个月
items.description: ANA SWANSON, KEITH BRADSHER2026年9月24日周三，美国财政部长贝森特在华盛顿，准备与中国官员会晤。 Nathan Howard/Reuters Scott Bessent, the Treasury secretary who is leading trade talks with China this week, said Wednesday in an interview on Fox News that the United States and China had agreed to extend a trade truce for two more months past a November deadline. 周三，本周主持对华贸易谈判的美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特在接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，美中两国已同意将贸易休战协议在11月到期后再延长两个月。 The truce was struck in South Korea last year after President Trump imposed steep tariffs on Chinese exports and the United States and China became embroiled in a tit-for-tat trade war. The truce has involved the United States’ suspending certain tariffs and other restrictions on the Chinese economy, and China’s agreeing to provide a steady flow of rare earth minerals needed by U.S. factories making cars, semiconductors, planes, power tools and other products. 该休战协议于去年在韩国达成。在那之前，特朗普总统对中国出口商品征收了高额关税，美中两国陷入了针锋相对的贸易战。休战协议的内容包括：美国暂停对中国经济实施的部分关税及其他限制，中国则同意稳定供应美国汽车、半导体、飞机、电动工具及其他产品所需的稀土矿物。 The agreement will be extended until Jan. 10, Mr. Bessent said, “to give us more time to see what we can do on the economic front.” 贝森特表示，协议将延长至明年1月10日，“给我们更多时间来探讨经济领域能采取哪些措施”。 Mr. Bessent gave the interview around the same time that Mr. Trump was greeting the Chinese leader Xi Jinping with a lavish ceremony at an air base outside Washington for the start of a multiday state visit. 贝森特接受采访时，特朗普总统正在华盛顿郊外的一个空军基地举行盛大仪式，迎接中国国家主席习近平，他将进行为期数天的国事访问。 The visit will include another welcome ceremony with an honor guard at the White House, a meeting between the two presidents, a state dinner and a tour of the National Archives. It may be the second of as many as four in-person meetings that the two leaders will host this year, Mr. Bessent said. 此次访问行程还包括在白宫举行的另一场由仪仗队护卫的欢迎仪式、两国元首会晤、国宴以及参观国家档案馆。贝森特表示，两位领导人今年可能进行多达四次的面对面会晤，这是其中的第二次。 Chinese officials have not yet confirmed the extension of the trade truce. In a statement issued by Chinese state media after he arrived in the United States, Mr. Xi called for Beijing and Washington to focus on cooperation, and said he was looking forward to in-depth exchanges with Mr. Trump. 中国官方尚未证实延长贸易休战协议。习近平抵达美国后通过中国官方媒体发表声明，呼吁北京和华盛顿聚焦合作，并表示期待与特朗普总统进行深入交流。 The Treasury secretary said he met again today with He Lifeng, the Chinese vice premier, whom he had also met with on Sunday, “to see if we could do a bigger deal.” Mr. Bessent said that the two sides were working to reduce tariffs on $30 billion of imports from each country, and that the countries would probably also make announcements relating to financial services and agricultural purchases. 财政部长表示，他周三再次与中国副总理何立峰举行了会晤（两人周日也曾会面），“看看我们能否达成一项更大的协议”。贝森特表示，双方正在努力削减各自国家价值300亿美元进口商品的关税，且两国可能还会就金融服务和农产品采购发布相关声明。 Mr. Bessent admitted that China was “behind schedule” on some agricultural purchases, and he said the United States was encouraging the country to increase those. 贝森特承认，中国在某些农产品采购方面“落后于进度”，他表示美国正在鼓励中国加大采购力度。 协议将使美国和中国能够搁置分歧，迎接未来几周的四项重要事宜。对美国而言，包括11月3日的中期选举和12月14日至15日在迈阿密举行的二十国集团领导人峰会。 The agreement will allow the United States and China to put aside their differences through four major events in the coming weeks. For the United States, that includes the midterm elections on Nov. 3 and the Group of 20 summit of world leaders in Miami on Dec. 14 and 15. 对中国而言，这包括10月26日至29日在北京举行的中共二十届五中全会，以及11月18日至19日在深圳举行的亚太经合组织领导人非正式会议。 For China, that includes the annual gathering of the Communist Party’s Central Committee in Beijing from Oct. 26 to 29 and the summit of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation presidents and prime ministers in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 18 and 19. 如果华盛顿峰会进展顺利，预计特朗普和习近平将分别出席对方在深圳和迈阿密举办的会议。这些会晤或许能为两位领导人及其首席贸易谈判代表提供更多机会，在1月10日之前达成更多协议。 If the current summit in Washington goes well, Mr. Trump and Mr. Xi are tentatively expected to attend each other’s events in Shenzhen and Miami. items.title: 习近平访美，其健康状况引发广泛关注
items.description: 储百亮2026年9月24日 When China’s leader, Xi Jinping, arrives at Joint Base Andrews, every step he takes down the stairs from his plane will be scrutinized for clues about his health. 中国领导人习近平抵达安德鲁斯联合基地时，他从专机舷梯上走下来的每一步都会受到仔细审视，以寻找有关他健康状况的蛛丝马迹。 Mr. Xi is China’s most dominant leader in decades: He is preparing to claim an all-but-certain fourth term in power from late next year, and there is no sign of a likely successor waiting in the wings. And at 73, Mr. Xi is old enough that any stumble or missed meeting ignites speculation abroad about his health. (The topic is heavily censored in China.) 习近平是中国数十年来最强势的领导人：他正准备从明年年底开始，几乎毫无悬念地开启第四个任期，而且没有任何迹象显示有潜在的继任者在等待接棒。与此同时，现年73岁的习近平年事已高，以至于任何一次踉跄或缺席会议都会在海外引发有关其健康状况的猜测。(这一话题在中国国内受到严格审查。) No matter what happens on the stairs or during Mr. Xi’s three-day visit to Washington, guesswork about his health and probable longevity is sure to persist. 无论习近平在舷梯上的表现如何，也无论他为期三天的华盛顿之行中发生什么，外界围绕其健康状况与可能寿命的种种猜测，肯定还会持续下去。 China’s Communist Party does not have clear rules of succession if a leader becomes incapacitated or dies, and Mr. Xi magnified the uncertainties by overturning retirement norms. Mr. Xi’s predecessor, Hu Jintao, retired in 2012 at 69, and his cognitive decline appeared visible in 2022, when he was abruptly escorted from his chair at a party congress, looking confused and upset. 中国共产党目前并没有一套明确的继承规则来应对领导人丧失行为能力或去世的情况，而习近平打破退休惯例更是进一步增加了这种不确定性。习近平的前任胡锦涛于2012年退休，当时69岁；到2022年，他的认知能力衰退迹象已较为明显——当时他在一场党代会上被突然搀扶离席，神情显得困惑又不安。 In August, Mr. Xi stepped slowly down the stairway of his plane, holding his wife’s hand, when they visited Kyrgyzstan, igniting rumors online about his health. 今年8月习近平夫妇访问吉尔吉斯斯坦时，他牵着妻子的手缓慢走下飞机舷梯，由此引发了网上有关他健康状况的传言。 The discussion intensified this month after he skipped a dinner at a regional leaders’ meeting in New Delhi. Mr. Xi was absent from a dinner for the BRICS group of developing countries — which includes Brazil, Russia, India and China — according to Indian news reports and a diplomat from one of the participating countries. 本月，他缺席在新德里举行的一次地区领导人会议的晚宴后，相关讨论进一步升温。据印度媒体报道及一名与会国外交官透露，习近平缺席了金砖国家的一场晚宴。金砖国家是一个由发展中国家组成的集团，其中包括巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国。 There was no suggestion that Mr. Xi was seriously ill. When he left New Delhi, he climbed the stairs to his plane unaided. Still, the absence fed questions in some foreign news reports about Mr. Xi’s health and stamina. 目前并无迹象表明习近平患有严重疾病。他离开新德里时是在无人搀扶的情况下独自登上飞机舷梯的。尽管如此，这次缺席仍在一些海外媒体报道中引发了对习近平健康状况与体力的种种疑问。 Mr. Xi is a bulky man who has said he became a smoker from his youth in the Chinese countryside, but details of his lifestyle are unclear. A friend of Mr. Xi told U.S. diplomats in 2009 that Mr. Xi, then preparing to succeed Mr. Hu, “did not drink or do drugs,” according to a diplomatic cable disclosed by WikiLeaks. 习近平身材魁梧。他曾说，自己年轻时在中国农村生活期间开始吸烟，但外界并不清楚他的生活习惯细节。维基解密披露的一份外交电报显示，习近平的一位友人2009年曾告诉美国外交官，当时正准备接替胡锦涛的习近平“不喝酒不吸毒”。 But Dennis Wilder, a former C.I.A. senior analyst who tracked Chinese leaders, told The Wall Street Journal that Mr. Xi had a reputation as a frequent drinker and longtime smoker who did not like to exercise. 但据《华尔街日报》报道，曾长期跟踪研究中国领导人的中情局前高级分析师韦德宁(Dennis Wilder)表示，习近平素有嗜酒的名声，长期吸烟，而且不喜欢运动。 Mr. Xi has not publicly commented on his health or plans for retiring or staying in office. Last year, he was inadvertently caught on a microphone chatting with Russia’s president, Vladimir V. Putin, about living forever. “People rarely lived to be over 70, but these days, at 70, you are still a child,” a man who appeared to be translating Mr. Xi’s remarks to Mr. Putin was recorded saying in Russian. 习近平从未公开谈论自己的健康状况，也没有公开谈论退休或继续执政的打算。去年，他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京闲聊长生不老的话题时，谈话意外被麦克风录了下来。录音中，一名似乎是在向普京翻译习近平讲话的人用俄语说道：“过去人们活不过70岁，现在70岁还算孩。” Whatever his health, Mr. Xi gets some of the most attentive medical care in the world. Chinese leaders have their own health care system that provides round-the-clock care and checkups at elite hospitals, including the military-run 301 Hospital near the leadership’s headquarters in Beijing. 无论习近平的健康状况如何，他都能获得世界上最周到的医疗照护。中国领导人拥有专门的医疗保健体系，可获得全天候医疗服务和检查，地点包括北京中央领导机关附近、由军方管理的301医院等顶级医院。 储百亮(Chris Buckley)是《纽约时报》首席中国记者，自台北报道中国和台湾问题，重点关注政治、社会变革以及安全和军事问题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

Putin, about living forever . “People rarely lived to be over 70, but these days, at 70, you are still a child,” a man who appeared to be translating Mr. Xi’s remarks to Mr. Putin was recorded saying in Russian. 习近平从未公开谈论自己的健康状况，也没有公开谈论退休或继续执政的打算。去年，他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京闲聊 长生不老 的话题时，谈话意外被麦克风录了下来。录音中，一名似乎是在向普京翻译习近平讲话的人用俄语说道：“过去人们活不过70岁，现在70岁还算孩。” Whatever his health, Mr. Xi gets some of the most attentive medical care in the world. Chinese leaders have their own health care system that provides round-the-clock care and checkups at elite hospitals, including the military-run 301 Hospital near the leadership’s headquarters in Beijing. 无论习近平的健康状况如何，他都能获得世界上最周到的医疗照护。中国领导人拥有专门的医疗保健体系，可获得全天候医疗服务和检查，地点包括北京中央领导机关附近、由军方管理的 301医院 等顶级医院。 储百亮( Chris Buckley )是《纽约时报》首席中国记者，自台北报道中国和台湾问题，重点关注政治、社会变革以及安全和军事问题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 习近平抵美，特朗普罕见前往安德鲁斯联合基地迎接
items.description: ZOLAN KANNO-YOUNGS2026年9月24日周三，特朗普总统在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地迎接中国国家主席习近平。 Doug Mills/The New York Times President Trump took the rare step of meeting President Xi Jinping of China at Joint Base Andrews to kick off a visit between two superpower rivals confronting mounting concerns over artificial intelligence and a shaky trade truce. Presidents typically meet foreign leaders at the White House, but Mr. Trump instead welcomed Mr. Xi with a lavish ceremony when his plane landed on Wednesday evening. 特朗普总统采取罕见的举措，在安德鲁斯联合基地会见中国国家主席习近平，以此拉开此次访问的序幕，目前这两个超级大国对手正面临着日益加剧的人工智能担忧，以及摇摇欲坠的贸易休战。总统通常在白宫会见外国领导人，但特朗普却在周三晚上习近平的专机降落时，以一场奢华的仪式欢迎他。 Hints of common ground soon emerged. Shortly after the two leaders shook hands on the tarmac, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the countries had agreed to extend a one-year trade agreement that had been set to expire in November. The two-month extension, which continues a suspension of certain U.S. tariffs in return for a steady flow of rare earth minerals from China, will “give us more time to see what we can do on the economic front,” Mr. Bessent told Fox News. 双方很快显露出达成共识的迹象。在两国领导人于停机坪握手后不久，财政部长贝森特表示，两国已同意将原定于11月到期的为期一年的贸易协议延长。贝森特告诉福克斯新闻，这项为期两个月的延期协议，将继续暂停征收美国的某些关税，以换取中国稳定供应稀土矿产，这将“给我们更多时间来探讨经济领域能采取哪些措施”。 The elaborate welcome ceremony, which included a red carpet lined by U.S. service members and a military flyover, is the start of a nearly two-day visit of pomp and circumstance, including another welcome ceremony with an honor guard at the White House, a meeting between the two presidents, a state dinner and a tour of the National Archives. 这场精心准备的欢迎仪式包括由美军官兵列队护卫的红毯，以及军机编队飞越，标志着这场为期近两天的隆重访问拉开帷幕，访问行程还包括白宫的另一场由仪仗队护卫的欢迎仪式、两国总统会晤、一场国宴以及参观国家档案馆。 Mr. Xi’s visit comes at a tumultuous time for the two leaders, even if foreign policy analysts expect few major breakthroughs by the summit’s end. Mr. Xi is overseeing an economy in its worst shape in decades. And just months before midterm elections, Mr. Trump is confronting low approval ratings rooted in Americans’ frustration over high energy prices caused in part by the U.S.-Israeli war in Iran. 习近平此次访问正值两位领导人面临动荡时期，尽管外交政策分析人士预计峰会结束时几乎不会取得什么重大突破。习近平正面临着中国数十年以来最严峻的经济形势。而在中期选举前仅数月之际，特朗普正面临着低迷的支持率，源于美国人对高能源价格的沮丧，而高能源价格部分是由美以在伊朗的战争造成的。 It remains to be seen whether Mr. Trump will confront Mr. Xi on several points of tension. Just last month, Mr. Trump gave a prime-time address accusing China of interfering in the 2020 election. And China has taken an active role assisting Iran, according to multiple U.S. officials, including by providing Tehran with satellite imagery and access to a spy satellite that Iran’s military forces have used to mount attacks in the region. 特朗普先生是否会在若干争议问题上与习近平针锋相对还有待观察。就在上个月，特朗普发表黄金时段讲话，指责中国干预2020年大选。此外，据多位美国官员称，中国在援助伊朗方面发挥了积极作用，包括向德黑兰提供卫星图像以及间谍卫星的访问权限，伊朗军队曾利用该卫星在该地区发动攻击。 But recently, Mr. Trump has appeared more focused on accommodating the leader that he has described as “a friend.” 但最近，特朗普似乎更专注于安抚这位被他称为“朋友”的领导人。 Here’s what else to know: 以下是需要了解的其他内容： • Artificial intelligence: A.I. is on the agenda as concerns mount in the United States about its potential threats, including from China, as some U.S. officials worry that it could enhance China’s ability to launch cyberattacks or crack military codes. • 人工智能：随着美国对其潜在威胁（包括来自中国的威胁）的担忧不断加剧，人工智能被提上了议程，一些美国官员担心，人工智能可能会增强中国发动网络攻击或破解军事密码的能力。 • State dinner: Mr. Trump is hosting Mr. Xi for a state dinner on Thursday, an event expected to be attended by some of America’s biggest A.I. and tech titans, including executives from OpenAI, Google and Nvidia. • 国宴：特朗普将于周四为习近平举行国宴，预计美国一些顶尖人工智能和科技领域的巨头将出席此次活动将出席该活动，包括OpenAI、谷歌和英伟达的高管。 相关报道 习近平如何看待“习特会” 2026年9月22日 美中元首峰会聚焦人工智能议题 2026年9月23日 最受欢迎 中日僵局难解，高市早苗向特朗普“求助” 美国再一次误判中国的毁灭性代价 张又侠被开除党籍，将面临军事法庭审判 习近平如何看待“习特会”：占据政治优势、底气更足 美中元首峰会聚焦人工智能议题，但恐难有实质进展 “习特会”最棘手议题之一：中国稀土出口管制 中国豪赌“人工智能大跃进”，经济却陷入大麻烦 习近平以强势姿态访美，特朗普该与他讨论什么？ “习特会”在即，中美贸易“暗战”小动作不断 最不寻常的冷战间谍：让他选择叛逃的性秘密 国际 中国 商业与经济 镜头 科技 科学 健康 教育 文化 风尚 旅游 房地产 观点与评论 国际 亚太 南亚 美国 美洲 欧洲 中东 非洲 中国 时政 经济 社会 中外关系 港澳台 商业与经济 全球经济 中国经济 交易录 文化 阅读 艺术 电影与电视 体育 风尚 时尚 美食与美酒 生活方式 观点与评论 专栏作者 观点 漫画 更多 镜头 科技 科技公司 科技与你 科学 健康 教育 旅游 房地产 免费下载 纽约时报中文网 iOS 和 Android App 点击下载iOS App 点击下载Android App© 2026 The New York Times Company. 获取更多RSS： https://feedx.net https://feedx.site

items.title: anthropics/financial-services
items.description: Claude for Financial Services Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for the financial-services workflows we see most — investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management. Everything here is available two ways from one source: install it as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deploy it through the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine. Same system prompt, same skills — you choose where it runs. Important Nothing in this repository constitutes investment, legal, tax, or accounting advice. These agents draft analyst work product — models, memos, research notes, reconciliations — for review by a qualified professional. They do not make investment recommendations, execute transactions, bind risk, post to a ledger, or approve onboarding; every output is staged for human sign-off. You are responsible for verifying outputs and for compliance with the laws and regulations that apply to your firm. What's in the repo: Agents — named, end-to-end workflow agents (Pitch Agent, Market Researcher, GL Reconciler, …). Each ships as a Cowork plugin and as a Claude Managed Agent template you deploy via /v1/agents. Vertical plugins — the underlying skills, slash commands, and data connectors, bundled by FSI vertical. Install these on their own if you just want /comps, /dcf, /earnings and the connectors without a full agent. Agents Each agent is named for the workflow it runs. They're starting points: install the ones that match your work, then tune the prompts, skills, and connectors to how your firm does it. Each agent plugin is self-contained — it bundles the skills it uses, so installing the agent is all you need. Function Agent What it does Coverage & advisory Pitch Agent Comps, precedents, LBO → branded pitch deck, end to end Meeting Prep Agent Briefing pack before every client meeting Research & modeling Market Researcher Sector or theme → industry overview, competitive landscape, peer comps, ideas shortlist Earnings Reviewer Earnings call + filings → model update → note draft Model Builder DCF, LBO, 3-statement, comps — live in Excel Fund admin & finance ops Valuation Reviewer Ingests GP packages, runs valuation template, stages LP reporting GL Reconciler Finds breaks, traces root cause, routes for sign-off Month-End Closer Accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary Statement Auditor Audits LP statements before distribution Operations & onboarding KYC Screener Parses onboarding docs, runs the rules engine, flags gaps For Managed Agent deployment — agent.yaml, leaf-worker subagents, steering-event examples, and per-agent security notes — see managed-agent-cookbooks/. Repository Layout plugins/ agent-plugins/ # Named agents — one self-contained plugin each vertical-plugins/ # Skill + command bundles by FSI vertical, plus MCP connectors partner-built/ # Partner-authored plugins (LSEG, S&P Global) managed-agent-cookbooks/ # Claude Managed Agent cookbooks — one dir per agent claude-for-msft-365-install/ # Admin tooling to provision the Claude Microsoft 365 add-in scripts/ # deploy-managed-agent.sh · check.py · validate.py · orchestrate.py · sync-agent-skills.py Getting Started Cowork In Cowork, open Settings → Plugins → Add plugin and either: Paste this repo URL — https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services — then pick the agents and verticals you want from the marketplace list, or Upload a zip — zip any directory under plugins/ (e.g. plugins/agent-plugins/pitch-agent/) and drop it in. Claude Code # Add the marketplace claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services # Core skills + connectors (install first) claude plugin install financial-analysis@claude-for-financial-services # Named agents — pick the ones you want claude plugin install pitch-agent@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install gl-reconciler@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install market-researcher@claude-for-financial-services # Vertical skill bundles claude plugin install investment-banking@claude-for-financial-services claude plugin install equity-research@claude-for-financial-services Once installed, agents appear in Cowork dispatch, skills fire automatically when relevant, and slash commands are available in your session (/comps, /dcf, /earnings, /ic-memo, …). Claude Managed Agents export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... scripts/deploy-managed-agent.sh gl-reconciler Each template under managed-agent-cookbooks/ references the same system prompt and skills as its plugin counterpart. The deploy script resolves file references, uploads skills, creates leaf-worker subagents, and POSTs the orchestrator to /v1/agents. See scripts/orchestrate.py for a reference event loop that routes handoff_request events between agents via your own orchestration layer. Research Preview: subagent delegation (callable_agents) is a preview capability. See per-agent READMEs for security and handoff guidance. How It Fits Together What it is Where it lives Agents Self-contained plugins that own a workflow end to end — system prompt plus the skills it uses. Cowork and the Managed Agent wrapper both reference the same directory. plugins/agent-plugins/ / Skills Domain expertise, conventions, and step-by-step methods Claude draws on automatically when relevant. Authored once in the verticals; each agent bundles a synced copy of the ones it needs. plugins/vertical-plugins/ /skills/ (source) · plugins/agent-plugins/ /skills/ (bundled) Commands Slash actions you trigger explicitly (/comps, /earnings, /ic-memo). plugins/vertical-plugins/ /commands/ Connectors MCP servers that wire Claude to your data — terminals, research platforms, document stores. plugins/vertical-plugins/financial-analysis/.mcp.json Managed-agent wrappers agent.yaml + depth-1 subagents + steering examples for headless deployment. managed-agent-cookbooks/ / Everything is file-based — markdown and JSON, no build step. Vertical Plugins Start with financial-analysis — it carries the shared modeling skills and all data connectors. Add verticals for the workflows you need. Plugin What it adds financial-analysis (core) Comps, DCF, LBO, 3-statement, deck QC, Excel audit. All 11 data connectors. investment-banking CIMs, teasers, process letters, buyer lists, merger models, deal tracking. equity-research Earnings notes, initiations, model updates, thesis and catalyst tracking. private-equity Sourcing, screening, diligence checklists, IC memos, portfolio monitoring. fund-admin GL recon, break tracing, accruals, roll-forwards, variance commentary, NAV tie-out. operations KYC document parsing and rules-grid evaluation. claude-for-financial-advisors Advisor workflows: meeting prep and follow-up, compliance pre-check, prospect intake, rebalance review, alts and estate briefs, on live data from the advisor's CRM, portfolio, planning, and estate platforms. lseg (partner) Bond RV, swap curves, FX carry, options vol, macro-rates monitoring on LSEG data. sp-global (partner) Tear sheets, earnings previews, funding digests on S&P Capital IQ. MCP Integrations All connectors are centralized in the financial-analysis core plugin and shared across the rest. items.title: google/ax
items.description: Google's open agentic orchestration runtime https://agentexecutor.io AX Warning We are still actively refining our core concepts, protocols, and specifications. We will likely to introduce major breaking changes prior to a stable release. Declare an agentic task with workspaces and gateway specifications. AX sandboxes it, wires up its workspace, fences its network, and helps running it at scale. AX is a high-throughput, declarative orchestrator to run billions of autonomous agent workloads in a cluster. It runs on top of Agent Substrate for sandboxed execution and is built to run billions of tasks per cluster. If you have used Kubernetes, ax will feel similar. # task.yaml apiVersion: ax.io/v1alpha1 kind: Workspace metadata: name: golang spec: git: - repo: https://github.com/golang/go.git branch: "my-fix" --- apiVersion: ax.io/v1alpha1 kind: Task metadata: name: test spec: workspaces: - name: golang goal: "Ensure that Go tool chain is available and is built from source" debug: true # lets you `ax ssh` into the sandbox Then apply it, watch it come up, and look over the agent's shoulder: ax apply -f task.yaml ax watch task test ax ssh test -- ls -al /workspace Why? Agents are a new kind of workload. They are neither stateless microservices nor run-to-completion batch jobs. They accumulate state, need strict isolation, call out to model APIs and tool servers, and can burn money in a loop if nobody is watching. AX gives you four small primitives that handle all of that declaratively: You want to... AX gives you Run untrusted agent code in an isolated sandbox with CPU/memory limits Task Pre-wire Git repos, MCP servers, and skill packages so every agent starts warm Workspace Lock outbound traffic down to an explicit host allowlist Gateway Configure which LLM the platform itself uses, with credentials from a Kubernetes secret Model Pause an idle agent and pick up exactly where it left off ax suspend / ax resume Shell into a running agent to see what it is doing ax ssh Everything is expressed as ax.io/v1alpha1 manifests and applied with a single command. Quick start 1. Install the CLI go install github.com/google/ax/cmd/ax@latest This puts the ax binary in $(go env GOPATH)/bin. Make sure that directory is on your PATH. 2. Deploy the control plane You need a Kubernetes cluster, ko (brew install ko), a container registry your cluster can pull from, and a reachable Agent Substrate Control API (in-cluster default: api.ate-system.svc.cluster.local:443). make deploy AX_IMAGE_REPO= This deploys Redis, then builds and deploys the control plane images with ko. Everything lands in the ax-system namespace. 3. Run your first task ax apply -f examples/task.yaml # Task + Workspace + Gateway + Model in one file ax get tasks # NAME ATESPACE PHASE ACTOR WORKER-IP AGE # task123 default Running task123 10.20.3.67 1m ax watch task task123 # stream phase and condition changes live ax ssh task123 -- ls -la /workspace # poke around inside the sandbox ax suspend task task123 # checkpoint and pause ax resume task task123 # pick up where it left off Want to see the whole lifecycle end to end? Run ./demo.sh. It applies a custom workspace, waits for readiness, runs commands over ax ssh, and suspends the task. Documentation Guide Read it to... Concepts Learn what a Task, Workspace, Gateway, and Model each do, and how a task moves through phases and conditions. Manifests Write your own YAML, with an annotated example of every kind. Sandbox See what the runner does on boot and what your command can rely on: metadata server, guest services, environment. Runners Understand the contract between the control plane and the task container, and build your own runner image to replace the default. Networking Reach a running task through the atenet router from the cluster, your laptop, or a gRPC client. Architecture Understand how the control plane fits together, plus the API reference. Development Build, test, and ship changes to AX itself. Roadmap See planned milestones across core specs, actor architecture, agentic environments, and governance. CLI usage ax talks to the control plane over gRPC. It is deliberately kubectl-shaped: apply, get, describe, watch, delete, plus a few agent-specific verbs. Everyday commands # Apply anything (multi-document YAML, file or stdin) ax apply -f examples/task.yaml # Tasks ax get tasks # list ax get tasks -a my-atespace # list in another atespace ax get task task123 # full spec + live status as YAML ax describe task task123 # human-readable detail ax watch task task123 # stream status and condition transitions ax suspend task task123 # checkpoint actor state and pause ax resume task task123 # resume a suspended task ax delete task task123 # Shell into the running sandbox ax ssh task123 # interactive shell (task needs spec.debug: true) ax ssh task123 -- ls -la /workspace # one-off command ax ssh task123 -- python3 main.py # Gateways, workspaces, models follow the same pattern ax get gateways # NAME ATESPACE LISTENERS EGRESS-HOSTS # default-gateway default 8494/gRPC,8080/HTTP * ax describe gateway default-gateway ax delete gateway default-gateway ax get workspaces # NAME ATESPACE GIT-REPOS MCP-SERVERS # default-workspace default 1 1 ax describe workspace default-workspace ax delete workspace default-workspace ax get models # NAME ATESPACE PROVIDER MODEL # default-model default google gemini-3.8-flash ax describe model default-model ax delete model default-model # Connection plumbing ax ctx # active kube context and how ax is reaching the control plane ax tunnel list # background tunnels (state lives in ~/.ax/tunnels) ax tunnel stop ax version Works with kubectx ax follows your active Kubernetes context. Switch clusters and ax resolves and tunnels to that cluster's control plane in the background. kubectx staging-cluster ax get tasks kubectx prod-cluster ax get tasks # Or target a context without switching ax --context=dev-cluster get tasks Global flags Flag Description Default -a, --atespace Atespace scope for the command default -n, --namespace Kubernetes namespace where AX is installed ax-system --context Kubernetes context to target active kubectx / current-context --server Control plane address, bypassing auto-detection derived from kube context, or $AX_SERVER License Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE for details.

items.title: BuilderIO/agent-native
items.description: A framework for building agentic apps https://www.agent-native.com Agent-Native Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that pair autonomous work with a purpose-built UI. Define each capability once as an action: the agent uses it as a tool, and the UI calls it from code. Quick start npx --yes @agent-native/core@latest create my-agent --standalone --template chat Follow the getting started guide for a full intro to the framework. Why build agents with UIs? Coding agents work with more than a text box. Their environment provides context, tools, files, tests, and previews that make their capabilities and results visible. Knowledge work needs that same kind of environment. A UI shows what an agent can do and gives people familiar ways to inspect, edit, approve, and share its work. How Agent-Native works Shared actions. The agent calls each capability as a tool, and the UI calls it from code. Both paths use the same validation, permissions, and implementation. Shared data. Work done by the agent appears in the UI, and work done in the UI is available to the agent. Shared application state. The agent receives relevant UI state, such as the current page, selected record, or active view. The agent does not click through the UI. It works through the same action layer as the UI. Example: a shared action Create actions/hello.ts: import { defineAction } from "@agent-native/core/action"; import { z } from "zod"; // One action powers every app surface: UI, agent, HTTP, MCP, A2A, and CLI. export default defineAction({ description: "Return a friendly greeting.", schema: z.object({ name: z.string().default("world").describe("Name to greet"), }), http: { method: "GET" }, run: async ({ name }) => { return { message: `Hello, ${name}!` }; }, }); The agent receives hello as a tool. React calls the same function with useActionQuery("hello", { name: "Alex" }). Agent-Native also exposes it through HTTP, MCP, A2A, and the CLI. Included Agent chat: Let people delegate work, ask questions, and review results in the same UI. Authentication and permissions: Control who can access and change shared work. Skills and memory: Give agents reusable expertise and persistent context. Automations: Run agent work on schedules or events. Agent teams: Delegate work to specialist agents in the same workspace or across connected agents. PostgreSQL backend: Use PostgreSQL in production and PGlite for local development on any Nitro-compatible host. Bring your LLM, SQL database, tools, and infrastructure. Everything you build stays yours. See Agent-Native in action: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ef51644b-6506-46d8-8083-0af7b7e5b65c Open-source agents Start from one of these agents or use it as an example for your own. Clips Record and understand meetings, screens, and voice notes. Design Generate and refine interactive designs. Slides Create and edit on-brand presentations. Analytics Ask questions of your data and build dashboards. Calendar Find time, schedule events, and manage bookings. Mail Prioritize email, draft replies, and follow up. Assets Create and organize on-brand media. Content Draft, organize, and publish content. Plans Create and review visual plans with diagrams, wireframes, and prototypes. Explore the full app gallery, or start with the framework guide. Documentation and community Read the documentation. Join Discord to ask questions, share what you're building, and get help. Contributing Working on this repository itself? See DEVELOPMENT.md for local setup, workspace structure, and guard scripts. License MIT
